info.name: Task Management API
info.description:
Task & Engagement Management Tool.

Every request is self-contained: a pre-request script signs in as the role that request needs, so you can run any folder in any order, and the whole collection runs clean under Newman.

Demo users (password `Password123!`): admin, manager1, manager2, member1..member4.

The **Authorization checks** folder is meant to return 400/403/409 - each request asserts the failure it should get.
